purpose: add actual WT-to-mutant sequence information to the mutation-response branch by extracting residue-local ESM2 representations without reading activity, sensitization, or residual-response labels

claim_boundary.permitted_interpretation: a preregistered new-information feature source for a later drug-conditioned mutation-response mechanism

reconstruction.substitution_pattern: one to four underscore-delimited canonical AA-position-AA substitutions inside construct parentheses
reconstruction.required_reference_check: reference_sequence[position-1] must equal stated source amino acid for every substitution
reconstruction.multi_substitution_rule: apply all substitutions simultaneously before taking any mutant window
unavailable_routes: NO_PARSABLE_SUBSTITUTION including insertions, deletions, ITDs, fusions and shorthand constructs

representation.checkpoint_source: local immutable checkpoint only; no network fetch
representation.site_center_embedding: final-layer token at the mutated residue in the local window
representation.site_window_mean_embedding: mean final-layer representation over amino-acid tokens, excluding BOS and EOS
construct_aggregation: mean WT center embedding across sites
mean mutant center embedding across sites
mean mutant-minus-WT center delta across sites
signed per-dimension maximum-absolute center delta across sites
mean mutant-minus-WT window-mean delta across sites
representation.unavailable_embedding_rule: all five construct-level vectors are exact float32 zero and availability is false
representation.inference_precision: CUDA autocast float16 with float32 saved outputs

required_audits: allowed columns read and forbidden label columns not read
finite embeddings and nonzero delta norms for every available construct
exact-zero vectors for every unavailable construct
saved construct manifest, site manifest and five float32 vector matrices with hashes

required_comparators: V10 mutation model with explicit mutation tokens only
capacity-matched model with shuffled ESM2 delta vectors within gene
local delta without explicit mutation tokens
future_model_boundary.same_kirhub_internal_boundary: all model development remains internal until a genuinely independent mutation-response dataset or experiment is supplied

hard_stops: abort on any input or checkpoint hash mismatch
never read response labels during feature extraction
never guess isoform offsets for four mismatched constructs
never encode unavailable constructs as negative response
never call the extracted embeddings a validated model or SOTA result
